summary: VitalikButerin 提出协议原生 DVT：质押密钥在少数节点间秘密分享，所有签名阈值签署，超过三分之二节点正常即可避免罚没。Nero_eth 分析 Glamsterdam 的最坏区块大小与 calldata 重定价。nixorokish 在以太坊博客发布 Checkpoint #8 核心开发会议综述。EIP-7773 依 ACDE #228 更新并合并，EIP-7954 列入 CFI。

items.title: ethresear.ch：Glamsterdam 的最坏区块大小与 calldata 重定价
items.note: （Nero_eth）20:59：最坏区块大小问题多来自对抗性构造而非正常使用，平均区块很小但最坏情况不然。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Worst-Case Block Size and Calldata Repricing for Glamsterdam
items.note_en: (Nero_eth), 20:59: worst case block size keeps surfacing through adversarial constructions rather than honest use; average blocks are small but worst cases are not.

items.title: ethresear.ch：以太坊质押的原生 DVT
items.note: （vbuterin）20:51：密钥在几个节点间秘密分享、所有签名阈值签署，只要超过三分之二节点正常就不会被罚没或遭受不活跃惩罚。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Native DVT for Ethereum staking
items.note_en: (vbuterin), 20:51: the key is secret shared across a few nodes and every signature is threshold signed, so stakers avoid slashing and inactivity leaks as long as more than two thirds of nodes are correct.

summary_en: VitalikButerin proposed native DVT: the staking key is secret shared across a few nodes with threshold signatures, staying safe from slashing as long as more than two thirds of nodes work. Nero_eth analyzed worst case block size and calldata repricing for Glamsterdam. nixorokish published the Checkpoint #8 core dev recap on the Ethereum blog. EIP-7773 was updated per ACDE #228 and merged, listing EIP-7954 as CFI.
